key_idea: Inductively construct the manifold by using the equivariant mapping class group of $S^3\times S^3$ to twist the group action at infinity, allowing transitions between different generators while strictly maintaining non-negative Ricci curvature.
reason: The proof relies on a highly surprising and elegant core idea: twisting the geometry at infinity via the mapping class group to modify the group action. However, executing this idea to achieve the full result requires an enormously intricate inductive gluing construction with heavy bookkeeping across meticulously managed scales.
